task_name: Collect Wood, Upgrade Three Residential Buildings to Reach Level 4, and Claim Two Journal Chests

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: Immediately after freeing City Storage space when Wood and Planks/Nails can be collected and three residential buildings are ready to upgrade.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Upgrading these three residential buildings pushes the city to Level 4 (unlocking Hammers, the Hardware Store, and City Storage) and completes both the 'Happy City' and 'Busy Manufacturing' City Journal chapters for 1,300 total bonus Simoleons.
preconditions: Finished Wood on factory and Planks on Building Supplies Store
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Collect the finished materials, upgrade the three ready homes, and claim both journal reward chests.

steps.who: floating Planks on Building Supplies Store
yellow hard hat with green checkmark on the central apartment building
steps.briefing: drag Planks (1/1) onto the building to upgrade it and reach City Level 4.

steps.who: yellow hard hats on two lower residential zones
steps.briefing: drag Metal (13/6) onto the first zone and Metal (7/1) onto the second zone to upgrade both.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect finished Metal and re-queue Metal in the factories.
open the 'Happy City' journal, click 'Claim', and open the chest for 700 Simoleons.
click 'Claim' and open the second chest for 600 Simoleons.
